structured.explanation: Pins that HTTP status code 500 at the server error threshold is classified as retryable with reason 'server_status', while status code 499 below the threshold is non-retryable.
structured.test_code:
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router._internal.providers.retry import (
    RetryClassification,
    classify_status_code,
)

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_PROVIDER_RETRY_CLASSIFICATION[revision==1]")
def test_server_error_status_threshold_classification() -> None:
    decision_server = classify_status_code(500)
    assert decision_server.classification == RetryClassification.RETRYABLE
    assert (decision_server.retryable, decision_server.reason) == (
        True,
        "server_status",
    )

    decision_below = classify_status_code(499)
    assert decision_below.classification == RetryClassification.NON_RETRYABLE
    assert (decision_below.retryable, decision_below.reason) == (
        False,
        "status_not_retryable",
    )
